**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}

Dear [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744)
I shall be glad to have fresh editions of [Beginnings of Christian History](../books.html#119) and of the [Pigeon Pie](../books.html#34).

My engineering [nephew](../persons.html#1630) has routed up an atlas of Keith Johnstone of manageable size.

If that does not prove sufficient I shall try [Cassell](../others.html#216)

Yours truly

C M Yonge
